## Supported Claim Or Question

- Supported Claim Or Question: Does the final Windows-facing VS Code last-mile candidate preserve exact Core-owned Transport text and avoid unnecessary automatic preview while reducing first-use Workspace preparation latency without weakening qualification?
- Evidence Role: Anchor-owned bounded source, negative host regression and manually run Core CLI integration checkpoint. Not installed-Windows Sigma acceptance or Marketplace readiness.
- Target Artifact: Finish VS Code Extension — Integration And Final Human Acceptance Gate.
- Review Context: Human Sigma observed all three package variants, pointer selection, Major 034, Replace and Transition without remaining functional blockers. Remaining requests are automatic Transport Preview only for exactly one qualified pointer and repeated 8–11-second Workspace-qualified pre-tasks. Existing Anchor-to-Anchor selected Handoff controls this bounded VS Code continuation.

## Provenance

- Known Source: Exact grounded 17-Workspace Anchor-to-Anchor carrier; qualified VS Code continuation; human screenshot feedback in this conversation; local inspection of `src/operatorTrees.ts`, `src/packageBuilder.ts`, `src/operatorParty.ts`, and `src/vscode/transportCompletionPresentation.ts`; executed `test/transport-auto-preview.regression.cjs`, `test/transport-completion-source.test.cjs`, `test/incomingWorkspacePicker.behavior.cjs`, `test/operatorPartyPicker.behavior.cjs`, `test/major-attach-host-contract.test.cjs`, `test/authoringBoundaries.regression.cjs`, `test/webviewSourceContext.regression.cjs`, `test/nativeAgentRoleSync.regression.cjs`; manual portable Core `project-transition-neighborhood` three runs against received VS Code Workspace root.
- Preservation Basis: Read-only Core qualifications, unchanged semantic Core projection and 17-Workspace carrier ancestry; only VS Code host-presentation and startup orchestration source plus one regression file are changed. Qualified carrier input bytes remain immutable. No remote mutation or release authorization.
- Provenance Limits: Full `npm run dev:build`, installed Windows test, Windows 8–11-second latency timing, and clean Marketplace `release:check` are not verified in the isolated sandbox. `test/run.mjs` requires `dist` which is not present in this continuation; this is a test limitation, not a passing or failing product verdict.

## Evidence Material

- automatic-preview-guard
  - Material: `src/operatorTrees.ts` `showPreparedTransportTab` previously opened the Core Transport receipt after every finished package, even with zero pointers or multiple pointers. It now selects only packages with exactly one qualified route from the already Core-qualified Transport queue; projects that exact route, and compares `receipt.clipboardText` against the route's exact `transportText` before invoking the existing read-only Markdown Preview. No route is guessed from a filename, route count, or user Role. Generic/zero-route Bootstrap and Workspace packages do not auto-preview. Multiple pointers require explicit route selection. Manual `Copy Transport Text` and `Guided Entry` continue to open the same presenter on operator action.
  - Material Kind: Exact local VS Code source delta and negative host regression.
  - Description: UI presentation only; no Core identity, authority, routing or clipboard bytes modified.
- automatic-preview-negative-test
  - Material: `test/transport-auto-preview.regression.cjs` exercises the actual private host method under transpilation and checks zero/one/two qualified routes, exact qualified route ID, zero unintended clipboard claim, and fail-closed Core transport-text mismatch. `test/transport-completion-source.test.cjs` continues to verify read-only Markdown rendering and exact clipboard checks.
  - Material Kind: Executed host-method behavioral tests.
  - Description: Both tests PASS in local sandbox; not the installed Windows UI.
- workspace-prefetch-overlap
  - Material: `src/operatorTrees.ts` startup begins the existing cached Core-qualified local Workspace and authoring-model prefetches before awaiting restored Transport queue qualification. Previously these prefetches ran after potentially slow Transport queue orientation. The unchanged cache still invalidates on Workspace changes and `.topics` semantic edits, and every mutation / authoring action retains its existing exact Core checks. This is an overlap of read-only preparation, not skip, persist, or bypass of qualification.
  - Material Kind: Source trace and host orchestration change.
  - Description: Possible improvement to first-action perceived latency; no verified Windows speedup. Independent Core per-root processes are still bounded to 3 concurrent operations.
- core-transition-manual-check
  - Material: Manual portable `project-transition-neighborhood <received-vscode-root> --output-schema tiinex.evidence.v1` ran three times in the sandbox. All produced three candidates with no qualification findings; observed wall time approximately 1.09–1.18 seconds per process. No Transition dedupe or semantic Core code changed.
  - Material Kind: Executed Core CLI manual integration check.
  - Description: These Core process times cannot be extrapolated to installed Windows Workspace qualification or package latencies.
- previous-sigma-positive-observations
  - Material: Previous Sigma human screenshots report Major 034 builds, all three packaging variants, qualified pointer packages, correct diff-only Replace preselection, three unique Transition choices, and read-only Markdown Preview. These already-passing operations are not rewritten.
  - Material Kind: Human installed-Windows observation from conversation, not a fresh acceptance of this candidate.
  - Description: Preserve working behavior and narrow final human test.

## Bounded Verification Notes

- PASS: `test/transport-auto-preview.regression.cjs`, `test/transport-completion-source.test.cjs`, `test/incomingWorkspacePicker.behavior.cjs`, `test/operatorPartyPicker.behavior.cjs`, `test/major-attach-host-contract.test.cjs`, `test/authoringBoundaries.regression.cjs`, `test/webviewSourceContext.regression.cjs`, and `test/nativeAgentRoleSync.regression.cjs`.
- PASS: TypeScript transpilation diagnostics (modified operator tree, transport presenter and unchanged builder) show no syntax errors. Not a full typecheck.
- PASS: Manual qualified Core Transition neighborhood read against the carried VS Code Workspace produces three candidates and consistent clean findings.
- NOT VERIFIED: Full dependency-backed VS Code build / actual Windows startup 8–11-second duration, pointer-triggered preview in installed host, `release:check`, VSIX installation and human Sigma acceptance. No npm registry investigation, automatic major, artifact reduction, remote write, or Marketplace publication.

## Preservation And Fidelity

- Preservation State: All intended 17 qualified Workspace contexts are required in the formal return. Incoming carrier Workspaces are immutable; only VS Code's writable continuation is changed.
- Fidelity Notes: Qualified Transport route IDs and exact Core text are never modified; only automatic presentation timing is gated. Startup overlap preserves Core qualification and failure semantics, with no new persistent semantic cache or Workspace count guard.
- Known Losses: No measurable Windows p50/p95 latency improvement has yet been demonstrated; installed VS Code UI and dependency-backed release checks remain human/release-environment gates.

## Interpretation Limits

- Must Not Be Treated As: Authority to skip Core qualification, infer Host/Role authority, assume no other work remains, or declare Sigma final acceptance.
- Not Yet Used As: Published release ticket, clean VSIX acceptance, Task closure, artifact reduction or remote mutation.
- Does Not Prove: Windows speedup, reduction policy, published Core parity or Marketplace release readiness.
- Does Not Mean: The original 8–11-second issue has vanished; only an overlap optimization and presentation guard are source-verifiable in this sandbox.
- Must Not Be Used To Claim: Any additional semantic authority beyond the selected bounded Anchor continuation, or evidence that a generic Workspace carrier has exactly one qualified Handoff Pointer.
